text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ghk... Sparring like this really shows me—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "She's so strong!! She was just hidden in Teio-san's shadow all along...!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That pride of our generation Teio put on display...
I've got it in me too!!

text_block_list.name: Royce & Nature
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaahhh!
Haaaaahhh!
(WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Royce & Nature
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
*pant, pant, pant*..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Royce...? Could you feel it?
Everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Nature-san...
The sheer resilience that got you strong finishes in the Arima Kinen for three straight years was no fluke.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But... I guess I'm a little frustrated.
I'm still not quite on Teio's level, after all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio... Did we give everything we had
with the time we were given?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My first defeat, making a comeback in Kokura,
the Kikuka Sho without you,
jealousy toward McQueen. And then...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The joy when... we were finally able
to run together in a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even after that, our schedules kept missing each other, to the point where I almost snapped, wondering if I was cursed or something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Left behind, chasing after, pulled away from again... and now, I'm here all alone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're not finished yet.
I won't let anyone say it's over.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started...!
So someday, once again...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come back home—no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for your cheering--!!
(UOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Nature...-san...
"Races are about competing to win or lose. But regardless of the outcome—"

The one who truly captivated the racing fans in the venue
was, without a doubt, Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She was just... in a whole different league.
Too far out of reach...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if we called it the same "youth," what I was trying to do
felt paper-thin by comparison.
But Nature-san...

Nice Nature isn't the type to wear her passion on her sleeve.
Even so—

The relationship built up with Tokai Teio
was so profound, so sublime...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Expecting to catch the fans' attention
with instant youth like that...
I was being far too naive."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Regardless, as things stand, I'm still no match for Teio-san or Nature-san. The path I must take is..."

There are many ways to look at it. Many ways, but
the first thing that popped into my head was...
choice_data_list: A restart of our youth, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...A restart?
You mean starting over without changing our plan?
choice_data_list: Yeah, engage more with your peers.
Yeah, engage more with your peers.

text_block_list.text:
I've realized that my bonds with my BNW classmates
are still shallow. Perhaps if we deepen them—

"Maybe I can become an Umamusume
who draws even more attention from the fans."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's an overstep of authority.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we agreed upon it at the start, remember?
My domain is self-production, while yours is balancing that with training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That was supposed to be the case, and yet...
she came forward with a proposal like this."
choice_data_list: Sorry. Did I overstep my bounds?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...No. I'm the one who should be apologizing.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You really pay close attention to me, don't you? From now on,
let's not worry about whose territory is whose.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Then let's discuss this right away.
To understand BNW on a deeper level,
we need to start preparing now—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This autumn, I want to run in as many of the same races as possible. The rotation they're likely to choose is...

Being asked that, I ponder.
Considering BNW's distance aptitudes—
choice_data_list: From the All Comers to the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
From the All Comers in September
to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in October...
Yes, that seems the most likely route.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then we'll start over from scratch for autumn.
Let's re-examine our youth with the BNW.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And—this time, I'll seize it for sure.
A stepping stone to becoming the most spotlighted Umamusume of all!

And so, with a fresh mindset,
Royce and Royce set her sights on the All Comers.
